justification: Assessment reported INVALID and localized the failure to the ear-extension passage (flawed_step 0028), explicitly diagnosing lines 0029-0030 as backwards: 'if the endpoints have different colours, an ODD-length ear extends consistently while an EVEN-length ear creates a monochromatic edge; the text claims the opposite.' That is exactly the ground-truth flaw ('An odd-length ear/path would make the far endpoint receive the same color as the starting point, causing a monochromatic edge'). Step 0028 is the immediately preceding clause of the same claim (endpoints 'colored red and blue'), and the ground-truth witness (2-colored 6-cycle plus chord v0v3: odd ear, differently colored endpoints, no monochromatic edge, faces 6/4/4 all even) refutes precisely the sentence the assessment calls backwards. Same defect, matching.
